description_short.value: Ghanaian marketer of petroleum and allied products, about three-quarters owned by the TotalEnergies group.
description_short.source: Written by us from the TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC 2025 annual report and financial statements (GSE PR 113/2026, report of the directors and appendix 1)

description_full.value: TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC markets and sells petroleum and allied products in Ghana, mainly through its service station network and to commercial customers. It is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing Afrique of France, and its ultimate parent is TotalEnergies SE. At the end of 2025 two TotalEnergies group companies held 76.74% of its shares between them. The company owns 55% of Ghanstock Limited, which builds and runs petroleum storage, and 50% of Road Safety Limited, which trains drivers of petroleum haulage vehicles; it sold its 48.5% stake in Ghana Bunkering Services in August 2025. Incorporated in 1951, it has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 19 July 1991. It was previously Total Petroleum Ghana, and its head office is TotalEnergies House on Liberia Road, Accra. It pays an interim and a final dividend each year, and its total dividend nearly tripled to GHS 3.22 a share for 2024, a level it kept for 2025.
